# X Bookmarks Dump — 150 saves through 2026-05-09

## Summary

Not a single source — a **behavioral dataset**. 150 X bookmarks spanning Feb 2026 → May 2026 (with a tail of older personal-interest saves from 2023). Treated as a snapshot of attention: what was loud enough in Tali's feed to get saved. The dominant cluster is *Polymarket / prediction-market trading bots built with Claude* (15+ posts, almost all engagement-bait threads with implausible P&L claims) — important as a behavioral signal about where the [[wiki/self/goals|$10K trading-bot goal]] is currently being routed, even though most of the linked work doesn't survive scrutiny. A second, quieter cluster covers genuinely substantive **agent engineering** (Karpathy's Sequoia talk, Anthropic agent-harness internals, Claude Skills, `ml-intern` autonomous research loop, Greg Isenberg's Obsidian-as-personal-OS masterclass — directly mirroring this vault). A third small cluster surfaces **real biomedical / physics research worth chasing** (wireless EMF gene switch in mice, autonomous AI agents running an HEP analysis end-to-end, BioReason-Pro for protein function, skyrmion-based memory).

## Key takeaways

- **The trading-bot path is dominating attention, not just intention.** At least 15 of 150 bookmarks (10% of all saves; ~20% of the post-Feb-2026 tail) are Polymarket / prediction-market hype threads. This isn't curiosity — it's a feedback loop. The X algorithm has learned what Tali clicks, and is feeding back exactly the dopamine that the [[wiki/self/goals|$10K car-repair goal]] primes for. Worth naming explicitly so the goal can be pursued without being dragged by the noise.
- **The hype is mostly fake; the underlying technical primitives are real.** Strip the "$1K → $14K in 48 hours" packaging and what's left is a small set of legitimate concepts: LMSR pricing (Polymarket isn't an order book), behavioral-fingerprint copy-trading (find the 0.51% who consistently win, mirror them), Bayesian belief updating, Kelly sizing, EV calculation. These belong in a real concept page — see [[wiki/concepts/prediction-markets]] — not as endorsement of the threads, but as the legitimate technical surface a real attempt would have to engage with.
- **Agent-engineering substance is the actually-load-bearing thread.** Karpathy's Sequoia agentic-engineering talk (#9), the Anthropic agent-harness internals (#47, #75 — 823-line retry system, structured memory architecture), Claude Skills internals (#28), `ml-intern` (#13, #18 — autonomous research loop replacing parts of HuggingFace's post-training team), and Greg Isenberg's Obsidian + Claude masterclass (#95) form a coherent reading list for the *actual* moat above the model. Reads as the signal under the noise — and it directly informs both the [[wiki/projects/origin-quantum-stack]] tooling thinking and the SaaS path in [[wiki/self/goals]].
- **Three biomedical/physics signals worth following up on.** Korean group's wireless EMF gene switch in mice at 60 Hz (#22) — if real, opens a new modality for non-invasive in-vivo control. AI agents autonomously executing a full HEP analysis pipeline (#94) — same template as `ml-intern` but applied to wet-and-detector science. BioReason-Pro (#101) — first reasoning-model-style architecture for protein function, relevant to the [[wiki/areas/biomedical/_overview|biomedical area]]. Skyrmion-controlled magnetic memory (#11) is more speculative but in the same family as the [[wiki/concepts/quantum-computing|post-Moore]] story.
- **The "China is shipping" pattern keeps repeating.** Ling-2.6-1T open-weights (#5), Kimi K2.6 (#19), MiroFish swarm simulator from a Chinese student (#110), Origin Quantum context already established. Reinforces the entrepreneurship-overview note that Chinese tech is a competitive landscape worth watching, not a footnote.
- **The 2023 tail (#137–#150) is identity material, not technical.** Drawing Black hairstyles, anime, Spider-Verse, jazz, Mel Blanc anecdotes. Not connected to current goals but consistent with [[wiki/self/identity]] and [[wiki/self/creative-voice]] — an X account that has held a coherent identity across years even as the technical interests evolved.
